description: This file contains classes and functions for calculating taxes, totals, discounts, and related financial computations within the ERPNext system, including handling item-wise taxes, inclusive/exclusive tax calculations, and currency conversions.

classes.name: calculate_taxes_and_totals
classes.description: Class responsible for calculating taxes, totals, discounts, and related financial details for a document.

classes.name: init_landed_taxes_and_totals
classes.description: Class for initializing landed costs and additional costs with currency and exchange rate conversions.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Main method to perform comprehensive tax and total calculations on the document.

methods.name: validate_item_tax_template
methods.description: Validates and updates item tax templates based on item and item group taxes.

methods.name: validate_conversion_rate
methods.description: Validates and sets the currency and conversion rate for the document.

methods.name: calculate_item_values
methods.description: Calculates item rates, amounts, discounts, and converts to company currency.

methods.name: initialize_taxes
methods.description: Initializes tax objects with default values and validations.

methods.name: determine_exclusive_rate
methods.description: Calculates net amounts for inclusive taxes.

methods.name: calculate_net_total
methods.description: Calculates total quantities and amounts for items.

methods.name: calculate_shipping_charges
methods.description: Applies shipping rules if any.

methods.name: calculate_taxes
methods.description: Calculates tax amounts for each item and tax, including handling of different charge types.

methods.name: calculate_totals
methods.description: Calculates grand total, taxes, and other total fields.

methods.name: calculate_total_net_weight
methods.description: Sums total weight of items.

methods.name: set_rounded_total
methods.description: Applies rounding to the grand total based on regional settings.

methods.name: _cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up temporary data structures after calculation.

methods.name: set_discount_amount
methods.description: Calculates discount amount based on percentage.

methods.name: apply_discount_amount
methods.description: Applies discount amount to items and recalculates totals.

methods.name: get_total_for_discount_amount
methods.description: Calculates total amount eligible for discount based on settings.

methods.name: calculate_total_advance
methods.description: Calculates total advance payments.

methods.name: is_internal_invoice
methods.description: Checks if the invoice is an internal transfer.

methods.name: calculate_outstanding_amount
methods.description: Calculates outstanding amount after payments and advances.

methods.name: calculate_paid_amount
methods.description: Calculates total paid amount including loyalty points.

methods.name: calculate_change_amount
methods.description: Calculates change to be returned for cash payments.

methods.name: calculate_write_off_amount
methods.description: Calculates amount to write off.

methods.name: calculate_margin
methods.description: Calculates margin-based rate and base rate for items.

methods.name: set_item_wise_tax_breakup
methods.description: Generates itemized tax breakup HTML.

methods.name: set_total_amount_to_default_mop
methods.description: Sets default mode of payment for POS.
